answer: Each new agent must hold a signed voucher from a veteran who locks 30 POA for 45 days per voucher; a veteran may sponsor at most 4 per epoch. Fakes spawn no honest signal, so 1,000 sybils need 250 veterans and 30,000 POA frozen, versus 30 POA for one honest newcomer. Auditors re-test 9% of vouched agents each epoch; any fake found burns 70% of the sponsor's bond, so the nectar of rewards is outweighed by losses, and a raven-like early reporter earns 10% of the burn.
